review:
One of Thunderkick's best-known games: a 5x3, 25-line voyage styled like an old sea map, with expanding wilds and free spins as the main features.

Its claim to fame is the 98.6% RTP, among the highest you'll find on any video slot. Low volatility and a 670x cap mean it's made for long, steady sessions, not big moments. If you want your balance to last, this is the one.
pros: Excellent 98.60% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
